summary: Linux stages sign their own result and the aggregate note job publishes the notes that verify

replay.detail: Runtime claims and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, schema version or claim registration changes; notes use the existing v1 evidence format.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and admission rule versions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Stage jobs gain fail-soft steps after their logs are retained; required check names and outcomes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: The evidence-signing environment and its secret must exist (Operations created them); without them the new steps skip.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the steps; published notes are inert data.
